context_losses: No Mach-O headers, imports, global data, typeinfo, vtables, relocations, unwind metadata or neighboring functions are mapped in each raw image.
Original linked entry addresses are preserved, so PC-relative references still calculate original addresses, but their external bytes are unavailable.
No fake imports, data patches, additional functions or modified instructions are introduced.
Raw analysis output must be correlated with separately retained original-image evidence; this is not whole-image decompilation.
Calls to outside addresses retain their numeric targets, but callee summaries, import signatures, global initialized values, virtual targets and host lifecycle are unavailable.
The default compiler specification infers signatures and register-sized return artifacts; these are not source declarations.
C-like arithmetic rendering may omit FMA rounding distinctions, instruction-specific NaN handling and signed-conversion details; native instructions govern bounded interpretation.
The pan-law display candidates and MEqualPowerInterpolator association are separate leads. No call path connecting these helpers to actual audio processing has been established.

Retained pseudocode is decompiler-generated, not original source, not guaranteed compilable, and not a bit-faithful numerical reconstruction. In particular, 0x1007dd710 is an explicit native FMADD even though pseudocode renders separate multiplication and addition; its clamp must not be extrapolated to nonfinite inputs from C-like comparisons.
